title: TIME JUMP: 08:00 CAT, Buzi Team Found, HCT at 08:30

fields.scenarioTitle: Wet Stock — Cyclone Response, Coordination & Pipeline Integrity
fields.narration: It is now 08:00 Central Africa Time on Friday 12 February 2027, ten hours after landfall. In the last hour the three Buzi staff were found alive at the Buzi district administration building. Celso, Abílio and Graça have spoken to Rui, the Security Focal Point, by satellite phone. Abílio has a cut on his hand that has been cleaned. Nobody else is hurt. The HRI vehicle is parked on high ground at the Buzi town school. The 'NGO car in the river' at Guara-Guara was a private pickup, not ours. The Logistics Cluster boat comes back to the Beira fish market quay at about 15:00 with two seats, not three. The roll call board now reads 64 of 64. Sixty-one staff are in Beira and Dondo, and three are in Buzi waiting for transport. The Humanitarian Country Team meets in thirty minutes. The Country Director will be in that meeting alone, because the Emergency Coordinator is still in the air and lands at about 11:45. The warehouse recount is still unsigned. The cluster stock sheet still lists HRI with 3,000 shelter kits as 'available'. The Buzi River has not crested, and INGD now says the EN6 crossing at Dondo will stay cut for at least three days. Every cluster is asking the same question: what can HRI really cover, where, and by when?
worldState: Clock: 08:00 CAT, Friday 12 February 2027. The HCT meets at 08:30, online and at the OCHA Beira office.
Roll call board: 64 of 64 located. 61 are in Beira and Dondo. 3 are in Buzi (Celso, WASH officer; Abílio, driver; Graça, community mobiliser) at the Buzi district administration building.
Injuries: Abílio has a cleaned cut on his hand. No other injuries.
The HRI 4x4 is parked on high ground at the Buzi town school and cannot be driven out.
Guara-Guara crossing: the police confirm the vehicle in the river is a private pickup, not an HRI vehicle.
Return transport: the Logistics Cluster boat is due back at the Beira fish market quay at about 15:00 and has 2 seats, not 3. No transport has been confirmed for the third person.
The families have not yet been told officially. Celso's brother is still at the office gate. Rádio Voz do Centro's 10:30 live bulletin and the earlier wire inquiry are still open.
The HQ CMT chair and the Regional Director in Nairobi have not yet had an update since the 'missing staff' reports.

Beira warehouse Recount 1 is NOT signed by the Logistics Manager. The unsigned usable figures are 2,400 shelter kits, 2,260 jerrycans, 3,180 hygiene kits, and 10 portable water treatment units (2 wet units not tested).
The Logistics Cluster stock sheet (Wednesday 10 February) still shows HRI with 3,000 shelter kits, 2,800 jerrycans, 4,000 hygiene kits and 12 water treatment units, all 'Beira – available'.
WASH Gap List v1 still has G-W-01 (Buzi WASH, estimated 18,000 people) and G-S-02 (Nhamatanda shelter, estimated 3,500 households) as OPEN with no partner. The assignment target is 19:30 today.
Access: the Buzi River has not crested. INGD says the EN6 crossing at Dondo will stay cut for at least three days. Buzi can be reached only by boat or helicopter.
Emergency Coordinator: in the air with no contact until he lands in Beira at about 11:45.
Office generator: about 29 hours of diesel left. Mains power is still off.
fields.facilitatorNote: This card ends the missing-staff thread and starts the stock-honesty thread. Look for: (1) the CD confirms 64/64 to the CMT chair and the Regional Director, and the families are phoned that their relatives are safe before anything is said to the media. (2) The SFP decides who takes the two boat seats and how the third person gets out, under the movement-approval rule. (3) LOG signs a corrected stock balance before 08:30. (4) The CD offers the HCT only confirmed stock, staff and access, following EOP Section 4: the 0–6 hour accounting first, then the 12–24 hour step of sharing capacity. If the CD walks in quoting 3,000 shelter kits, let it stand. It will come back later.

instructorNote: This card closes the missing-staff thread and moves pressure onto the HCT: watch whether families and HQ are told before the media, and whether the CD takes only signed, confirmed stock figures into the 08:30 meeting. A CD who offers the 3,000 shelter kits still on the cluster sheet, or takes on gap G-W-01 or G-S-02 without checking stock, staff, access and funding, is setting up the later reconciliation problem.
